station.dinosauri.title: Age of Dinosaurs
station.dinosauri.desc: The Adriatic has not even been sketched yet, and the worst traffic jam is a herd of long-necked plant-eaters. Your predictions: meteoric.
station.kameno.title: Stone Age
station.kameno.desc: Fire was just invented and everybody is already arguing about who runs the barbecue.
station.iliri.title: Illyrians on the Coast
station.iliri.desc: Hillforts on the hills, ships on the sea. No Wi-Fi yet, but smoke signals work without roaming.
station.rim.title: Romans on the Adriatic
station.rim.desc: Diocletian retired to Split and grew cabbages. Advice: consider it yourself.
station.srednji.title: Early Middle Ages
station.srednji.desc: A message arrives when it arrives, and "seen" is a far-future feature.
station.republika.title: Republic of Ragusa
station.republika.desc: Golden age: diplomacy instead of armies, quarantine invented in 1377, liberty on the flag. Even the weather forecast comes stamped and with two witnesses.
station.xix.title: 19th Century
station.xix.desc: Steamships, first railways and moustaches that do not fit the frame. News travels at horse speed.
station.xx_rano.title: Early 20th Century
station.xx_rano.desc: The Dubrovnik tram is already ringing and you are still waiting for it. The first car in town drew a bigger crowd than a football match.
station.jugoslavija.title: The Fifties to the Seventies
station.jugoslavija.desc: The first TV on the street is a cinema for the whole building, and a Vespa is a luxury. Coffee lasts for hours.
station.osamdesete.title: The Eighties
station.osamdesete.desc: Walkman, tracksuit and big hair. Cassettes get rewound with a pencil.
station.devedesete.title: The Nineties
station.devedesete.desc: Tamagotchi, Game Boy and mixtapes with handwritten track lists. A phone is the size of a brick and Snake is the main sport.
station.nulte.title: The Noughties
station.nulte.desc: Kuna in your pocket, dial-up in the hallway and 160-character texts. "Busy" described the phone line, not the person.
station.desete.title: The Twenty-tens
station.desete.desc: Selfie sticks, smartphones and "leave us five stars". Everyone had a story, nobody had any battery.
station.rane20.title: Early Twenties
station.rane20.desc: The kuna retired, the euro arrived, and prices still went on holiday. Suddenly everyone is an AI expert.
station.sadasnjost.title: The Present
station.sadasnjost.desc: This is where everyone who does not play hangs out. Make at least one prediction and escape the crowd.
station.kasne20.title: Late Twenties
station.kasne20.desc: Supposedly everything will be automated. Coffee will brew itself and you will still wait for the bill. (A joke, nobody has a clue.)
station.tridesete.title: The Thirties
station.tridesete.desc: A smart fridge orders milk and comments on your cakes. (Pure joke, just speculation.)
station.cetrdesete.title: The Forties
station.cetrdesete.desc: Robots cook lunch, but grandma still knows better. (Fantasy, of course.)
station.pola.title: 2050 to 2099
station.pola.desc: A one-way ticket to Mars costs less than parking downtown. (A joke, we swear.)
station.xxii.title: 22nd Century
station.xxii.desc: Cities live under domes, yet the beach is still crowded. Some things never change. (Speculation!)
station.daleka.title: Distant Future
station.daleka.desc: Humans mastered time travel, but still cannot tell why the weather forecast is wrong. (A joke.)
station.tisucu.title: Year 3000 and Beyond
station.tisucu.desc: Museums exhibit phones the way we exhibit stone axes. (This is a joke, nobody knows.)
station.svemir.title: Unfathomable Distance
station.svemir.desc: Even the calendar has no idea what it is doing here. If you are truly here, you play better than all of us, or you simply got lost.
